title: loop-status issue status
description: One file per issue at <statusDir>/<issue>.json. The build loop writes it; the status page only reads it. Every field except issue, state and updated is optional.

issue.description: Issue number; matches the file name.

agent.description: Agent working the issue, e.g. slice-owner.

logs.description: Folder under logsDir holding this issue's logs, e.g. issue-43 or bundle-43-46.

bundle.description: All issues worked together on one branch, this one included.

step.description: What is happening now, in a few words.

run.description: Build run number for this issue.

state.description: One of the config's states (default: queued, working, in-review, needs-you, blocked, merged).

message.description: Why it stopped, the last verdict, or other detail for the owner.

cost.description: Total agent cost in USD so far.
